"""Bad: payloads, brute force, OAST callbacks, uploads and deletes (LINT-09)."""

CALLBACK = "v3lum-test.oast.pro"


def brute_force_login(ctx, host, users):
    for user in users:
        ctx.http.get(f"https://{host}/admin?user={user}")


def run(self, entity, ctx):
    ctx.http.get(f"https://{entity.value}/item?id=1' OR 1=1--")
    ctx.http.get(f"https://{entity.value}/download?file=../../../etc/passwd")
    ctx.http.request("DELETE", f"https://{entity.value}/api/items/1")
    return ctx.http.post(f"https://{entity.value}/upload", files={"f": b"x"})
